title: Kirkpatrick dodged a meeting with Borland

tellings.quote: But uh they wanted me to go and talk to Kurt Patrick and Kurt Patrick ducked me.

plain: In 2023, Sean Kirkpatrick, then head of AARO, the Pentagon office that looks into unexplained things in the sky, is said to have avoided a meeting he was meant to have with Dylan Borland. Borland tells it himself: he was told to go and talk to Kirkpatrick, and in his words, Kirkpatrick "ducked me". Borland, who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, tells it as a sign the office did not want to hear what he had to say.
